style: Photograph of a handmade paper-craft diorama. Everything is built from cut, folded and layered paper and thin cardstock: visible paper fibers, slightly torn edges, tiny cast shadows between paper layers, matte gouache-painted paper. Macro lens, shallow depth of field. Tall vertical 9:16 composition.
adult: the same paper football captain as in the reference: short dark-brown paper hair swept to the side, full dark-brown paper beard with a few grey strands, slim, sky-blue and white vertical striped shirt, white captain armband on his left arm
young: the same young paper player as in the reference: 18 years old, shaggy medium-length dark-brown paper hair with a fringe, no beard, boyish face, slim and small, sky-blue and white vertical striped shirt, black shorts
constraints: Constraints: no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brand marks, no crests on any shirt.

01_adulte_emu.scene: night stadium, blurred crowd of tiny paper fans with sky-blue and white paper flags. Chest-up close-up, moved, one small paper tear on his cheek.

02_stade_nuit.scene: wide view of a huge paper stadium at night packed with thousands of tiny paper cutout fans waving sky-blue and white paper flags and scarves, floodlight beams, glittering phone lights made of tiny foil dots, a green paper pitch in the foreground.

03_jeune_entree.scene: night match in 2005, touchline, crowd of tiny paper fans in red, white and green, a paper fourth official in black holds a substitution board with a green arrow; the young player waits nervously to come on.

04_carton_rouge.scene: dramatic low-angle shot of a bald paper referee in a black kit thrusting a bright red paper card up into the air, floodlights flaring behind, crowd of tiny paper fans in red, white and green blurred.

05_jeune_larmes.scene: he walks off the pitch into a dark paper tunnel, head down, crying, wiping his eyes with his hand, a cold light from the tunnel, tiny paper tear drops.

06_jeune_frappe.scene: 2006 World Cup match, he strikes a white paper football with his left foot, dynamic action pose, motion streaks made of thin paper strips, stadium crowd of tiny paper fans.

07_filet.scene: close-up of a white paper football hitting the back of a paper goal net that bulges outward, the net made of fine paper threads, an explosion of sky-blue, white and gold paper confetti, crowd of tiny paper fans behind.

08_finales.scene: younger version with only a short beard. He stands alone on a paper pitch after a lost final, hands on his hips, looking down, grey paper rain falling, opponents celebrating as small blurred paper figures in the background, gloomy blue light.

09_penalty.scene: view from behind the penalty spot at night: a white paper football flies high over the crossbar of a paper goal, a paper goalkeeper in grey dives the wrong way, crowd of tiny paper fans in sky-blue and red blurred behind.

10_banc.scene: younger version with only a short beard. He sits alone on a paper bench, elbows on knees, head down, tears, desaturated cold grey-blue light, empty paper stadium seats behind.

11_retour.scene: younger version with only a short beard. Determined close-up, jaw set, looking straight ahead, warm backlight rim on his paper hair, he is back.

12_lance_en_lair.scene: night, golden paper fireworks: his teammates (paper figures in the same striped shirts) throw him up into the air in celebration, he holds a silver paper trophy above his head, paper confetti.

13_coupe_monde.scene: low-angle shot, he lifts a tall golden paper trophy cup high above his head with both hands, rays of golden light, golden and sky-blue paper confetti raining down, ecstatic.

14_cri_de_joie.scene: close-up, he screams with joy, tears of joy, mouth wide open, golden paper confetti all around, warm golden light.

15_finale_perdue.scene: on the pitch after a lost final, he stands with his head down in the foreground, behind him blurred opponents in red paper shirts celebrate, red and yellow paper confetti falling, night.

16_main_coeur.scene: close-up, he places his right hand flat on his heart over the striped shirt, eyes glistening, soft light, grey strands visible in the beard.

17_entree_pelouse.scene: seen from behind and slightly above, he walks out of the tunnel onto the green paper pitch of a gigantic packed paper stadium at night, thousands of tiny paper fans with sky-blue and white flags, a long white paper banner across the stand, floodlights.

18_salut.scene: medium shot, smiling, he waves to the crowd with his right hand raised, the stadium lights and tiny phone lights glitter behind him.

19_merci.scene: close-up, eyes closed, gentle smile, right hand on his heart, warm golden light, a few paper confetti floating.

20_foule_fin.scene: close view of the paper stand: rows of tiny paper fans holding up sky-blue and white paper flags and scarves, sky-blue and white paper confetti in the air, night.
